input.explanation:
The fault: deploy 53f02e9f renamed the metrics port in values-production.yaml (`metrics.portName: metrics` -> `http-metrics`), but deploy/scrape.yaml, the ServiceMonitor kept next to it, still picks its endpoint by `port: metrics`. A ServiceMonitor that names a port the Service doesn't have doesn't raise an error. It just ends up with no targets, so Prometheus stopped scraping at 19:27 while the shop kept serving /metrics as normal. The comments in both files say nothing checks that the two names agree.

The fix: change the endpoint's `port` in scrape.yaml to `http-metrics` so it matches the platform naming the deploy brought in. With this, the renaming deploy can stay rolled out, or be rolled out again, without losing metrics. A rollback isn't needed to keep them.

To stop this coming back, I added tests/io_shop/test_deploy_config.py. It reads `metrics.portName` from values-production.yaml and every `port:` on the ServiceMonitor's endpoints, and fails if the ServiceMonitor names a port the values don't define. It runs against the current code, where it fails (`metrics` vs `http-metrics`), and it will catch any future rename made on only one side. It parses the two files with the standard library only, so it adds no YAML dependency to the test suite.

files.content:
# How the platform's Prometheus collects the shop's metrics.
#
# The ServiceMonitor the platform applies with the shop's chart, kept in the
# repository beside how the shop is deployed, so that how it is collected
# changes in the same pull request as what it is collected from.
#
# It selects the shop's Service by label, then the endpoint to scrape on that
# Service by the port's *name* - never its number - so a port can move without
# anything here being touched.
#
# The name here has to be the one `metrics.portName` in values-production.yaml
# gives the port. A name that matches no port is not an error to the operator,
# it is a target list with nothing in it, and the shop goes on serving metrics
# nobody collects - so tests/io_shop/test_deploy_config.py checks the two agree.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: io-shop
  labels:
    release: prometheus
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: io-shop
  endpoints:
    - port: http-metrics
      path: /metrics
      interval: 15s

input.summary: Point the ServiceMonitor at the renamed metrics port (http-metrics) and test that it matches values
